name: Woodland Community College Dual Enrollment (Yolo Community College District)
what_you_do: You can take free college classes as a high school student. Some are offered at partner high schools (eleven offer them, including Woodland, Pioneer and Winters), and others are online or on campus.
who_can_apply: Current high school students who have finished 8th grade. Partner high school classes are arranged through your counselor. Tuition is free for 11 units or fewer.
pay_detail: Free up to 11 units ($46 per unit fee waived); books may cost
how_to_apply: Explore with your counselor, apply on CCCApply, set up your student account, submit the CCAP or High School Non-CCAP form, then register.
notes: Students may pay for books and materials. Check your counselor for term deadlines. Davis High was not on the CCAP list I saw, so a Davis student would use the non-CCAP route. Charter and homeschool students may need grade verification.
